planning_notes: Board: arduino:avr:uno; preserved authoritative pins D2/D3/D4 (bed call buttons), D7 (nurse confirm), D6 (buzzer), D13 (LED), TM1637 CLK=D8 and DIO=D5.
No explicit serial receive/command inputs were specified; therefore no serial_command_input or serial_integer_input requests are created.

No explicit required serial report messages/fields were provided (only that 'serial port' exists for call order, wait time, and processing logs). serial_channels are left empty because the exact reporting cadence and message format are not specified; these belong in SysML.

TM1637 display behavior ('bed number and seconds') requires a model-defined representation within the tm1637_number value (e.g., encoding seconds vs. bed number or timed alternation). Electrical interface supports only a single integer number; the encoding and update/alternation logic must be implemented in SysML.

Digital input polarity (pullup/active_high) for buttons is not specified in the circuit facts; catalog defaults are assumed. If the buttons are wired with pullups and active-low, set digital_input active_high accordingly in SysML logic only if allowed by the catalog configuration; otherwise wire/polarity must be confirmed.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个病房呼叫与响应记录系统，使用床位按钮 D2、D3、D4 分别对应三张床，护士确认按钮 D7、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、蜂鸣器 D6、LED D13 和串口。任一床位按下后系统记录呼叫顺序和等待时间并报警提示；确认按钮按下后清除当前最高优先级呼叫并输出处理日志。数码管显示当前等待最久的床位编号和秒数。
